sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>customer_account</collection><condition>!current.primary_sales_territory.nil() && current.primary_sales_territory.changes()</condition><description>When a Primary Sales Territory is assigned (or changed) on an account, set the Sales Owner to the user with Primary membership on that territory.</description><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Set Sales Owner from Primary Territory M</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    var territoryId = current.getValue('primary_sales_territory');
    if (!territoryId) {
        return;
    }

    var member = new GlideRecord('sn_tp_territory_membership_override');
    member.addQuery('territory', territoryId);
    member.addQuery('membershiptype', 'primary');
    member.addQuery('active', true);
    member.setLimit(1);
    member.query();

    if (member.next()) {
        current.sales_owner = member.getValue('user');
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-08-31 19:53:00</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>1b8026213b4f8b10d5260fa693e45abe</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Set Sales Owner from Primary Territory M</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Global" source="global">global</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Global">global</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_1b8026213b4f8b10d5260fa693e45abe</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-09 19:09:36</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=1b8026213b4f8b10d5260fa693e45abe"/></record_update>

sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>true</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>sn_tp_territory_membership_override</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Sync Sales Owner from Territory Membersh</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    if (current.getValue('membershiptype') != 'primary') {
        return;
    }
    if (!current.active) {
        return;
    }

    var accountGr = new GlideRecord('customer_account');
    accountGr.addQuery('primary_sales_territory', current.getValue('territory'));
    accountGr.query();

    while (accountGr.next()) {
        if (accountGr.getValue('sales_owner') != current.getValue('user')) {
            accountGr.setValue('sales_owner', current.getValue('user'));
            accountGr.update();
        }
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-09-08 23:30:58</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>5e2f98182b53cf104deaf02ac891bf61</sys_id><sys_mod_count>1</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Sync Sales Owner from Territory Membersh</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Quote Management Application" source="sn_quote_mgmt">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Quote Management Application">c2194b8ab72171101aaebe508e11a927</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_5e2f98182b53cf104deaf02ac891bf61</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-09-08 23:33:32</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=5e2f98182b53cf104deaf02ac891bf61"/></record_update>
